hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | tr -d '\r' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.js|*.svelte|*.json|*.css|*.md) bunx prettier --write "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | tr -d '\r' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.js|*.svelte) bunx eslint --fix "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
